newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down without buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down without buying interest.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices closed lower after yet another day of listless trading, dealers said on Wednesday.
The July RSS1 buyer was quoted by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board at 284.50 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.13) a kg, down half cent from Tuesday.
The board quoted July SMR20 buyer one cent lower at 267.50.
A checking with trading houses in the evening showed the SMR 20 being offered at 262 cents cents a kg, SMR CV at 332 cents, SMR L at 309, SMR 10 at 264 and drum latex at 228.
The INRO five-day average ended at 215.90 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on June 3 against 215.52 on May 2. The daily indicator was at 216.78 against 216.93.
A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
